tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring, REST APIs | 5+ yrs E-Commerce
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, and microservices. Proven record designing and executing PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, order-management data flows, and CI/CD cloud deployments. Strong techno-functional consulting: requirements analysis, user stories, and stakeholder coordination. Certified SAP Commerce Cloud professional with AI-assisted development experience.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce OMS Architect
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Dimple Thakkar’s focus on building next-generation commerce solutions on Salesforce. With 5+ years leading SAP Commerce Cloud projects at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in API-first architectures, order-management data flows, and large-scale integrations that align perfectly with the OMS architect role.

bullets.label: **API Integration**
bullets.text: Designed and delivered OCC REST services and PIM-to-Hybris pipelines that synchronized product data across global channels, mirroring the integration depth required for Salesforce Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: **Order Management Expertise**
bullets.text: Implemented end-to-end Order Management (OMS) modules, including pricing, catalog, and customer data, ensuring reliable order processing—core to any OMS architecture.

bullets.label: **Techno-Functional Leadership**
bullets.text: Worked directly with business stakeholders to translate requirements into functional specifications and user stories, driving seamless delivery in agile, international teams.

bullets.label: **Cloud-Native Delivery**
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) using Docker and Kubernetes, providing the cloud-native deployment experience essential for Salesforce Data Cloud integrations.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany with a valid work permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. Open to remote, hybrid or on-site collaboration. I look forward to discussing how my background can add value to your team.

tailoring.why_company: Dimple Thakkar’s reputation for delivering innovative Salesforce Commerce Cloud solutions aligns with my passion for building robust, API-driven e-commerce platforms. I am eager to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud integration expertise to accelerate your clients’ digital transformation and help shape cutting-edge OMS architectures within a forward-thinking team.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leverage my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud integration and OMS experience to drive innovative Salesforce Commerce Cloud solutions at Dimple Thakkar.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with extensive API and OMS experience. I’m keen to discuss how I can contribute to your Salesforce OMS architect role. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Salesforce OMS Architect – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Salesforce OMS Architect position. I bring over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, strong API integration skills, and proven order-management delivery. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your team.
